messages:
anna: Compliance ping — quarterly RBAC export (2026-Q1) has ~1.1k rows where the actor column is empty for role change events. Filing here to triage, need root cause and an action plan. Anyone seen this pattern before?
marc: I noticed a cluster of `role_update` events with `actor:null` around 2026-03-10 03:12–03:30 UTC. Quick ES check shows a spike that aligns with a deploy window.
chris: tagging infra — we rolled role-reconciler v0.9.0 at 2026-03-10 03:10 UTC. That release added an opt-in anonymization feature for actors (`anonymize_actors`) to support privacy requests; looks like the helm values file accidentally set it to `true` in prod.
anna: @chris if anonymize_actors=true, does that remove actor field from stored audit events or just redact plain-text before storage? Could KMS interaction affect this too?
chris: It redacts before shipping to ES, replacing actor with null and keeping a redaction marker. KMS is used for payload encryption at rest elsewhere, but this change shouldn't touch KMS. However, we had a KMS key rotation earlier that changed how envelope metadata was recorded — separate issue but worth verifying.
audit-bot: index role_events-2026-* — docs with actor:null = 1,164. top shards affected: shard-07, shard-11.
marc: grabbing a sample doc: 
```
{
  "event_type": "role_update",
  "ts": "2026-03-10T03:15:42Z",
  "actor": null,
  "redaction_marker": "anonymized-by-reconciler",
  "details": {"role":"support","target":"svc-account-xyz"}
}
```
chris: confirming config snippet from prod helm values (redacted): 
```
roleReconciler:
  image: quay/redwood/role-reconciler:0.9.0
  replicas: 4
  anonymize_actors: true  # oops, should be false
```
chris: plan: flip `anonymize_actors` to `false` in prod, rollout, and then run a backfill for the small affected window. I'll validate on staging first.
marc: for backfill we can try to reconstruct actor from older snapshots (S3 raw-event-archive) before the reconciler scrubbed it. There may be a copy in the archive with the raw payload. I'll run an ES query to list doc ids and then cross-ref snapshots. Example query: 
```
GET role_events-2026-03-10/_search
{ "query": { "term": { "actor": { "value": null } } }, "size": 1000 }
```
chris: backfill tool (non-prod tested): `python tools/backfill_audit.py --index role_events-2026-03-10 --match redaction_marker=anonymized-by-reconciler --source-snapshot s3://redwood-raw-events/2026-03-10 --dry-run`
chris: once staging looks good I'll coordinate a prod rollout during low traffic (target window 23:00–01:00 UTC). Need SRE + KMS decrypt permission for the backfill service account.
oncall-sre: I can take the rollout. Will deploy to staging now and smoke test. Will post the kubectl rollout link once done.
sophie: For auditors: we should regenerate the CSV export and attach an explanation/incident note. Compliance will want the delta and timing. Also need an attestation that anonymization was accidental.
marc: one wrinkle — some redacted docs also have missing envelope_kid field after the KMS rotation; if actor info was encrypted under an old envelope and not referenced correctly we might not be able to decrypt automatically. I'll enumerate envelopes and map to snapshots.
chris: good catch. Steps: 1) flip flag -> stop new redactions, 2) run snapshot cross-ref to recover actor for 03/10 window, 3) if snapshots lack envelope metadata we'll escalate to key ops for manual decrypt using retained key material.
anna: timeline for compliance? They want completed backfill + regenerated export within 48 hours if possible. Is that realistic?
chris: estimate: flip + short smoke tests = 1–2 hrs, targeted backfill for the spike window (03:10–03:40) = ~3–4 hrs depending on snapshot throughput, full-day backfill for all shards = up to 10 hrs. With SRE and key ops this is doable within 48 hours for the critical window. Full historical correction will take longer.
sophie: I'll inform compliance and draft the CSV regeneration plan. Add this to audit-trail:BACKFILL-3456 and record approvals.
marc: I'm starting extraction now — query running, will paste sample recovered actor if found.
audit-bot: update: extraction query found 312 matching S3 objects with non-null actor fields that map to the ES docs.
marc: recovered sample mapping: ES id `abc123` -> snapshot `s3://.../raw-2026-03-10/obj543` -> actor `svc-deploy-bot`. Looks promising.
chris: good. After we confirm, backfill script will call ES _update to set actor and add metadata `recovered_from_snapshot:true` and `recovered_by:marc`. We'll also add a compliance flag so generated CSV includes a footnote.
anna: thanks team. @oncall-sre post the prod rollout link and ETA when you have it. I'll follow up with compliance once we have a short remediation note. :thumbsup:
oncall-sre: staging rollout succeeded, health checks green. Prod window still 23:00 UTC. I'll post link before prod deploy. :eyes:
sophie: leaving a quick note for auditors: we will provide a CSV with corrected actors for 2026-03-10 and a remediation timeline; full historical backfill is a separate ticket.
chris: action items assigned: chris — flip flag & prod rollout; oncall-sre — perform deploy; marc — run extraction & backfill; sophie/anna — compliance comms. I'll update `incident-audit-2060456789` with links.
marc: pulling logs now, will update thread with final numbers once backfill completes.
anna: thanks all.
